blockers.title: The 0.3.0 release gate has not been passed. HEAD is unverified, CI has been red on every pushed commit since 2026-09-21, and at least two E2E specs fail deterministically
blockers.scenario: `npm run milestone:status` reports V05, F1 and UG2 as PENDING. The public Actions API shows 'Deterministic verification' failing on every push since ea8dec1 (2026-09-21): first E2E (student-management-gate) and, from 9a1de6e onward, the unit stage (tests/ocr-synthetic-regression.test.ts:439). Because the unit stage fails first, the full browser suite has not run on CI in 5 days, although 03 §6.1 makes CI the authority for that suite. HEAD 5c1e029 is a merge with no CI run and no recorded verify. UX1 (9a1de6e) removed the 'Dedotto dal foglio' caption, but tests/e2e/student-management-gate.spec.ts:28 still asserts it is visible, and that spec runs in all three projects including iphone-13-webkit-core. The plan names only s1-scan-phone-option as broken, so the list of known failures is incomplete. Nothing in the repository today supports freezing the local-only app.
blockers.suggestedFix: Do not freeze before UG2. First push the merged HEAD and get CI green, including the unit-stage fix S4 claims. Fix or update student-management-gate.spec.ts:28 as well as s1-scan-phone-option, then run verify:all on CI and complete F1/V05 (or have the owner descope V05) and UG2.

blockers.title: The milestone controller accepts hand-written or stale verification.json and ignores verificationScripts, commit and freshness, so it can record a false PASS
blockers.scenario: verificationPassed only checks status==='PASS' and that every checks[].status is PASS. It never compares the manifest's verificationScripts, gitCommit, node version or date. Probe: in a scratch copy I created an INTEGRATION_GATE milestone requiring ['verify:all'] and a hand-typed verification.json whose single check is `echo`. `milestone.mjs complete X` returned 'X: COMPLETE' and rewrote the manifest and plan. This already happened in the real repo. .evidence/V03/verification.json is hand-authored (no gitCommit or exitCode). Its E2E check is marked PASS, but it was 'not rerun' and was taken from a tree with uncommitted changes (browser-evidence headCommit 3ba5a38). The recorder stores only HEAD and not whether the tree was dirty: S4's verification says 5591d14, but it ran at 19:29:59Z on the uncommitted ae221b9 source, which was committed 39 s later. UX2 records 3dc4360 for code committed in ef7cdd8. UG2 could therefore be closed without verify:all ever running.
blockers.suggestedFix: Make completion require that verification.json came from the recorder. It should hold one check per manifest verificationScripts entry, each with exitCode 0. Store a tree hash from `git stash create` or `git write-tree` plus a dirty flag, and have complete() reject a dirty or mismatched tree and hand-edited files (for example with a content hash, or by re-running the scripts). Add these as refusal cases to self-test.

blockers.title: verify:e2e reuses any Vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:4174, including one from another worktree
blockers.scenario: run-e2e only checks that /@vite/client answers. It never checks that the server's root is this checkout. The playwright webServer also sets reuseExistingServer:!CI. Several worktrees and branches of this repo are in use concurrently (CVC_helper, CVC_helper-s4-ocr, claude/f1; another agent's server is on 4274 now). If one of them has a dev server on 4174, `npm run evidence -- UG2` runs Playwright against that worktree's source and records PASS for this commit. LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md says the reuse check guards against stale servers; it only confirms the server is Vite.
blockers.suggestedFix: Have run-e2e always start its own server on a free or unique port and pass it to Playwright through an environment baseURL. Alternatively, verify the server's root, for example by fetching /package.json or a per-run nonce module and comparing it with the local file. Set reuseExistingServer:false.

blockers.title: Real students' personal data, including minors' names and birth dates, is still published in the public GitHub repository
blockers.scenario: The GitHub API confirms FurioColombo/CVC_helper is public and has tag v0.2.0. The committed aggregate audit reports matches in: v0.2.0 and origin/codex/post-mvp-ux-planning (45 real surnames, 32 given-plus-surname pairs, 6 birth dates), and origin/main and origin/codex/0.3.0 (full given names and surname words). The current tree is clean: the audit reports 0 hits, and the scan screenshots I opened show only the synthetic fixture. The owner deferred any history rewrite. A frozen release would still be published next to minors' data, contrary to the explicit rule.
blockers.suggestedFix: Owner decision is needed before a freeze. Purge the affected blobs from all refs and the tag (git filter-repo), delete and re-create v0.2.0, force-push, and ask GitHub Support to purge cached views and PR refs. As an interim measure, make the repository private (Pages would then need a paid plan).

importantFindings.title: Pages deploys main without waiting for verification; three deploys went live from commits whose CI failed
importantFindings.scenario: The deploy workflow runs only build on push to main and has no dependency on CI. The Actions API shows 'Deploy to GitHub Pages' succeeded for 9a1de6e, 3dc4360 and ef7cdd8 while 'Deterministic verification' failed on the same SHAs. The live phone app was never gated by tests. Local main already points at the unverified 5c1e029, so one push would deploy it.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Make the deploy job need a verify job in the same workflow (or trigger it on workflow_run with conclusion==success). At minimum run verify plus check:ocr-offline at the Pages base path before upload-pages-artifact.

importantFindings.title: Dictation fetches executable ONNX Runtime code from cdn.jsdelivr.net; the privacy docs and V01 evidence say only huggingface.co is contacted
importantFindings.scenario: The app never sets env.backends.onnx.wasm.wasmPaths. transformers.js 4.2.0 therefore sets it at load to https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.30.0/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.{mjs,wasm} (the non-asyncify files on Safari). The built bundle defines versions.web='1.30.0', so that branch runs. With useWasmCache it then fetches both files and runs the .mjs from a blob in the app origin, which also holds minors' data in IndexedDB. There is no SRI. V01's claim that the CDN is 'a default it does not use here' rests on a measurement that never triggered dictation. As a result, the 26.8 MB local ort-wasm asset in dist/assets and the cvc-speech-runtime runtimeCaching rule are dead weight. The first dictation also depends on two third-party hosts, not one.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Before the pipeline loads, set wasmPaths to the locally emitted assets (import the ?url of the .mjs and .wasm) and precache or runtime-cache them. Then capture a Playwright network trace of a real first dictation with the network recorded and correct DEPLOY.md, CHANGELOG and V01 evidence.

importantFindings.title: The speech model revision is not pinned: onnx-community/whisper-base loads from the moving 'main' branch
importantFindings.scenario: pipeline() is called without `revision`, so every new install downloads whatever the third-party repo's main contains that day. An upstream re-export can change accuracy or break session creation for every new device without any code change. The UG1 onnxruntime 1.26 incident shows this kind of failure happens. The V03 benchmark records no model revision, so the accepted speech quality cannot be reproduced.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Pass `revision: '<commit sha>'` from a measured snapshot and record that sha in the benchmark evidence. Preferably self-host the model files same-origin with a pinned manifest.

importantFindings.title: Dictations longer than 30 s are silently cut, and the partial transcript is saved directly
importantFindings.scenario: transcribeAudio calls the Whisper pipeline without chunk_length_s. In transformers.js _call_whisper that means a single chunk, and WhisperFeatureExtractor slices the audio to n_samples (30 s), logging only a console warning. The recorder has no time limit or countdown. A 45 s evaluation or knowledge note loses its last ~15 s without any visible sign. Since V03 removed the accept step, the initial note saves immediately (schedule(...,0)). The V03 corpus clips are short, so the benchmark never exercised this.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Pass chunk_length_s:30 (with a stride) only when the decoded length is over 30 s, which costs short clips nothing. Or cap recording at about 28 s with a visible countdown and auto-stop. Add a unit test with a 40 s fixture.

importantFindings.title: Offline behaviour is not guarded by any gate, and physical offline checks are missing from the release checklist
importantFindings.location: package.json scripts (verify, verify:all); .github/workflows/ci.yml; docs/post-mvp/UG1_DEVICE_VALIDATION.md; vite.config.ts:99-100; src/components/CvcMark.tsx:14
importantFindings.scenario: check:ocr-offline is the only proof that the built PWA works offline. It is not part of verify, verify:all, CI or the deploy workflow; only U04 ever ran it. The E2E suite runs against the Vite dev server, so the service worker and precache are never tested. V01 evidence says an offline load 'belongs to UG2's physical checklist, which covers them in full', but UG1_DEVICE_VALIDATION.md has no airplane-mode or installed-app step. It also lacks N1's installed Back and icon checks. The precache glob excludes PNGs, and CvcMark has no fallback. Once the HTTP cache expires (Pages max-age is 600 s), an offline cold start probably shows no Home CVC symbol, which the spec requires. Boat marks do fall back to text.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Add check:ocr-offline, run at the Pages base path, to verify:all and CI. Add the brand PNGs to globPatterns or a CacheFirst route. Add installed-app airplane-mode steps (cold open, create or edit, scan) and N1's installed Back/icon checks to the UG2 device checklist.

importantFindings.title: Browser specs overwrite closed-milestone evidence, and it happened during this review
importantFindings.scenario: The tree was clean at the start of this review. It now has 11 modified tracked files (.evidence/UG1 ×9, .evidence/V02 ×2), written by a concurrent browser run; I ran no browser tests or builds. The 2026-09-25 development audit flagged this, but it was not fixed. A UG2 verify:all will rewrite UX1, UG1 and V02 evidence and leave a dirty tree, contrary to the clean-checkpoint rule, and closed evidence silently changes.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Write screenshots to testInfo.outputPath() by default. Copy to .evidence only behind an explicit CVC_EVIDENCE_REFRESH=<ID> that names the active milestone.

importantFindings.title: The scan review gate exists in three copies; S4's headline numbers and the synthetic regression do not test the production gate
importantFindings.scenario: needsReview, ageNeedsReview, nameReadingNeedsReview and candidateIsReady were copied 'literally' into the measurement script and again, with small differences, into the regression test. S4's closure claims (61→26 rows to review, ready rows 50→91) and the regression thresholds come from the copies. A later change that makes more low-confidence rows 'ready' in StudentScan.tsx would pass every test and every measurement.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Move the review predicates into a pure module (e.g. src/capabilities/studentScanReview.ts) and import it from StudentScan.tsx, the measurement script and the regression test. Add a unit test of that module on the synthetic fixture.

importantFindings.title: The PWA reloads itself when an update activates, which can discard in-progress work
importantFindings.scenario: With autoUpdate and no onNeedReload, vite-plugin-pwa's register code calls window.location.reload() on the 'activated' event. It does this for updates and for SW updates triggered in other tabs. After any push to main, a phone that opens the app mid-week installs the new SW and reloads a few seconds later. Unsaved scan-review rows (up to 40 reviewed candidates held in React state), an active dictation or a failed-evaluation retry are lost.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Use registerType:'prompt' (or supply onNeedReload) and apply the update only on explicit confirmation or when no pending or dirty state exists.

importantFindings.title: No in-app way to start a new course or erase course data
importantFindings.scenario: CourseCreation renders only when getActiveCourse() returns null, and saveActiveCourse has no other caller. After the first week, the only way to start the next course is to clear site data in browser settings. That wipes all history, the OCR/speech caches and, on some platforms, the installed app state. Minors' personal data otherwise stays on the device indefinitely with no in-app deletion. None of this is documented for the owner.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: The owner should decide before the freeze. At minimum, document the reset procedure. Better: add a confirmed 'Nuovo corso' in Impostazioni that deactivates the old course, plus an explicit 'Elimina dati corso'.

importantFindings.title: The tested crew-warning domain functions are not used by the UI, which rebuilds the rule inline
importantFindings.scenario: getBoatCrewWarnings and getCrewWarningSummary (unavailable red plus unresolved-fault yellow) are covered by table tests but imported only by tests. CrewManagement builds its own boat-unavailable warning and adds no boat-fault warning. The same holds for getSessionBoatStates, formatCrewAnnouncement, getCrewSizeStatus and getEvenCrewTargets, which are used only in tests. The RULE_HEAVY tests therefore prove code that is not shipped, and the two can drift.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Have CrewManagement use the domain functions, or delete them and move their tests onto the code paths the UI actually uses.

qolFindings.title: Microphone stays open during the first-use model download, and every getUserMedia failure is reported as a denied permission
qolFindings.scenario: On first use the OS mic indicator stays on through a ~100 MB download. NotFoundError or NotReadableError (no mic, mic busy) shows 'Permesso microfono non concesso'. An offline first use shows a generic failure, with no hint that a one-time download is needed.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Call prepare() before getUserMedia, or release the stream until the model is ready. Map error.name to specific messages and add an 'internet needed for first use' hint.

qolFindings.title: Tesseract worker and Whisper pipeline stay in memory for the whole session
qolFindings.scenario: Both singletons are never terminated or disposed. After a scan and a dictation, a low-memory phone holds the Tesseract heap, the ORT heap and the model together, which may get the tab killed.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Terminate the OCR worker after the review opens, and measure memory on a real low-end phone at UG2.

qolFindings.title: Harness hygiene gaps
qolFindings.scenario: milestone:self-test leaves an untracked .evidence/__synthetic__/. milestone:status prints 'Latest complete: S4' because of manifest order, not execution order. check-built-pwa's distPath accepts URLs that lack the base path, so a missing base prefix would pass. build (icons:build) rewrites tracked public/icons/*.png and svg.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Remove the synthetic dir after self-test. Order status output by the plan's execution order. Assert that every manifest and index URL starts with the base. Generate icons to a build directory or check them in without regenerating.

qolFindings.title: Stale or contradictory documentation
qolFindings.location: docs/post-mvp/0_3_0_OPEN_ITEMS.md (S4 'partial', splash colour owned by N1); .evidence/V01/deployment-evidence.json:66 (deploy 'push to main or codex/0.3.0'); 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md:1,580 ('0.2.0 cycle'); 02_MVP_SCOPE.md §4 (no V05, UX1 or UX2 amendment); docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md Servers
qolFindings.scenario: Agents reading these documents get the wrong owner and state for the launch colour (the plan says F1) and for S4. They also get a deploy trigger that no longer exists, and a V05 LLM path that the scope document never admits. LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT overstates what the reuse check guards.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Reconcile the documents in F1: add V05 and UX amendments to 02, retitle the spec and correct the V01 note.

qolFindings.title: Dead code
qolFindings.scenario: listFaultsForBoat is referenced nowhere, and the others are referenced only from tests. They add maintenance surface before the 1.0 schema work.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Delete them, or wire them into production code.

readinessGapsFor1_0: All tables are PowerSync Table.createLocalOnly (src/persistence/db.ts). Moving to synced tables needs a data-copy migration and a tested 0.1/0.2/0.3-to-synced path.
faults, crewMembers and evaluations carry no courseId. Per-course sync buckets would need denormalization or joins that sync rules handle poorly.

dutySettings stores ID lists as JSON text (fewerDayIds, extraDayIds, stayOverStudentIds, completedDayIds, acknowledgedWarningKeys). With multiple editors, last-write-wins on the whole column loses concurrent edits.
Only faults has createdAt/updatedAt. No table records the author, a version or tombstones, so conflict resolution and audit have nothing to work with.
There is no export, backup or restore and no navigator.storage.persist(). The only copy of a course lives in evictable browser storage.
A shared database of minors' personal data needs auth, authorization, retention and deletion rules. V05 would route roster photos to third-party AI and needs an explicit privacy notice.
Updating the service worker automatically across several clients risks version skew against a shared schema. Schema versioning and a compatibility handshake are needed.

The speech path depends on unpinned third-party hosts (huggingface.co model on 'main', jsDelivr ORT) and has not been tested on a physical iPhone. Scan has not been physically tested on iPhone either.
The harness needs verificationScripts enforcement, a check on the tree hash, deploy gated on CI, and the offline check in CI before it can serve as a release gate for 1.0.
Real students' personal data must be removed from public Git history before any wider sharing.
evidenceInspected: The whole of .milestones/manifest.json. A provenance audit of every required verification.json showed V03's is hand-written, and S4, UX2 and others were recorded against the parent commit of a dirty tree.

.evidence/V03/*, .evidence/S4/verification.json, privacy-audit.json, .evidence/V01/deployment-evidence.json, .evidence/UG1/speech-runtime-fix.json. Synthetic-fixture screenshots in S3, V04 and UG1 contain no real data.

scripts/milestone.mjs, record-verification.mjs, run-e2e.mjs, check-repository.mjs, check-built-pwa.mjs, check-ocr-offline.mjs, check-domain.ts, measure-scan-review.mjs, generate-app-icons.mjs; package.json; vite.config.ts; playwright.config.ts; .github/workflows/ci.yml and deploy-pages.yml; .gitignore

src/features/speech/*, src/capabilities/speech.ts, studentScan.ts (worker), src/features/students/StudentScan.tsx review predicates, tests/ocr-synthetic-regression.test.ts, CrewManagement.tsx warnings, crewWarnings.ts, App.tsx, main.tsx, db.ts, courses.ts, BoatIdentity.tsx, CvcMark.tsx

The built dist/ files sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, index.html and asset list, and URL strings in the transformers.web bundle, which show the jsDelivr wasmPaths default and versions.web=1.30.0. Also node_modules transformers onnx.js, whisper feature extractor, ASR pipeline and vite-plugin-pwa register.js.
The public GitHub Actions API: runs and job annotations for ea8dec1, 9a1de6e, 3dc4360, ef7cdd8 and 82d1bc0. Repository visibility is public, and tag v0.2.0 is published.

Commands run: check:repository, typecheck and lint all PASS. milestone:status and milestone:check passed for every COMPLETE milestone. A scratch-copy probe showed that milestone:complete accepts hand-typed INTEGRATION_GATE evidence. Scans for unused exports and stale E2E text. git status at the end showed 11 closed-milestone evidence files modified by a concurrent browser run, not by this review.
